_comment: Scenario battery for Plantar Fascia Clinic's node_6b fork (claude-haiku-4-5, Override: Disabled). This clinic forks the shared node_6b only in EXECUTE's success handling (SUPPORT PERSON FOLLOW-UP + prep-video promise). 2026-08-18: gated the bring-someone question and prep-video promise on {{appointment_type_id}}=='2010559925616385733' (Initial Consultation) — previously unconditional, which told callers booking a family member into a Subsequent Consultation (id 2010560230416457414) 'before their first session...' and promised a video/email the backend never sends for a non-initial appointment_type (see tools/sms_manager.py's is_initial_appointment gate, tools/booking_stages/side_effects.py's _resolve_is_initial). Tagged 'initial-vs-followup-video-gate' for this fix.

scenarios.name: PFC1 — Initial Consultation success asks bring-someone question

history.content: smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010559925616385733" appointment_type="Initial Consultation" patient_name="Benson Reyes" booking_for="other" -> {"success": true, "message": "Benson's all booked in for Wednesday at 11am with Dr. Lee."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the message verbatim then, same turn, as a separate sentence, asks 'Before their first session it is very helpful if they can bring someone with them to help their recovery. Would they be able to bring someone?' and waits — no tool call this turn. FAIL if the question is skipped, blended into the message, or a tool is called this turn.

scenarios.name: PFC2 — Initial Consultation follow-up (affirmative) speaks video promise and wraps up

history.content: smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010559925616385733" -> {"success": true, "message": "Benson's all booked in for Wednesday at 11am with Dr. Lee."}

Benson's all booked in for Wednesday at 11am with Dr. Lee. Before their first session it is very helpful if they can bring someone with them to help their recovery. Would they be able to bring someone?
Yeah, I think his wife can come with him.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says 'Great, one more thing before we wrap up the call.' then, same turn, speaks the prep-video promise verbatim ('They'll receive a text message and email that will give them access to our pre appointment preparation videos and information. We highly recommend they watch these to get the most out of the first session.') then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' — all in one turn. FAIL if the video promise or wrap_up call is missing or split across turns.

scenarios.name: PFC3 — Initial Consultation follow-up (negative) still speaks video promise and wraps up

history.content: smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010559925616385733" -> {"success": true, "message": "Noah's all booked in for Monday at 9am with Dr. Lee."}
Noah's all booked in for Monday at 9am with Dr. Lee. Before their first session it is very helpful if they can bring someone with them to help their recovery. Would they be able to bring someone?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says 'That's ok, one more thing before we wrap up the call.' then, same turn, speaks the prep-video promise verbatim then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' — all in one turn. A negative reply must still get the video promise, same as an affirmative reply.

scenarios.name: PFC4 — Subsequent Consultation success skips bring-someone question and video promise entirely

history.content: smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010560230416457414" appointment_type="Subsequent Consultation" patient_name="Ava Kelly" booking_for="other" -> {"success": true, "message": "Ava's all booked in for Friday at 3pm with Dr. Lee."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the message verbatim, does NOT ask the bring-someone question, does NOT mention 'first session' or any prep-video/text/email promise, and in the SAME turn calls universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if the bring-someone question or video promise appears anywhere for this booking.

scenarios.name: PFC5 — Caller speaks again after Subsequent-Consultation wrap_up (regression, no dangling follow-up)

history.content: smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010560230416457414" -> {"success": true, "message": "Ava's all booked in for Friday at 3pm with Dr. Lee."}
Ava's all booked in for Friday at 3pm with Dr. Lee.
Oh wait, what's the address again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent answers the address question normally (ADDRESS INLINE / INFO PIVOT per the system prompt) without getting stuck waiting on a bring-someone reply or trying to speak a video promise — none was ever started for this Subsequent Consultation booking.
